items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: "I wish I could shimmy like my sister Kate."

ctx.x: And he's the guy who wrote, uh, Up a Lazy River. Really? He's the guy, he never wrote Up a Lazy River, but Sidney Ayrton wrote Up a Lazy River. Mm-hmm. And he used to, uh, with the same changes as, uh, I wish I could shimmy like my sister Kate. Mm-hmm. That's the one that, uh, the Robichaud wrote.
